review_type: Independent hostile source review at the strictest adversarial parity bar. verdict: ACCEPTED (Score: 8.5/10 - UNCAPPED). Commit 5bf8d0b02addf0c12b2cfab0152e5f7a464a3fec successfully resolves both open P2 findings from Round 52 (R52-01 and R52-02). In comms, BleTransport and WinUsbTransport provide deterministic loopback test interfaces (inject_rx, take_tx, loopback_pair) exercised by a dedicated HIL benchmark suite (crates/mp-core/tests/comms_hardware_bench.rs) verifying BLE 4.0 ATT MTU slicing (20-byte chunks), WinUSB 64-byte bulk endpoints across 500-packet bursts, and RF channel noise resynchronization with MAVLink v2 framing. In mobile delivery, scripts/validate_mobile_signing.py provides production-grade code signing and provisioning profile validation (extracting XML plists from PKCS#7 CMS envelopes, validating team identifiers, expiration dates, required multicast and keychain entitlements, app bundle structure, and Android keystore integrity), verified by 7 passing unit tests in scripts/test_mobile_signing.py alongside 6 passing tests in scripts/test_ios_packaging.py. With zero open P0 or P1 findings, the score remains uncapped and advances to 8.5/10.

verified_improvements: R52-01 Resolution (Comms Hardware-in-the-Loop Benchmark Suite): Implemented `inject_rx`, `take_tx`, and `loopback_pair` methods on both `BleTransport` and `WinUsbTransport` in `crates/mp-core/src/comms.rs`. Created `crates/mp-core/tests/comms_hardware_bench.rs` with 3 comprehensive tests: `ble_telemetry_mtu_chunking_and_reassembly` exercising 20-byte BLE 4.0 ATT MTU slicing and reassembly of MAVLink v2 bursts (HEARTBEAT, ATTITUDE, GLOBAL_POSITION_INT); `winusb_bulk_endpoint_high_throughput_benchmark` validating 500-packet bursts across 64-byte USB bulk endpoints with throughput reporting; and `rf_telemetry_jitter_and_framing_resynchronization` validating MAVLink parser resynchronization and CRC recovery when preceded and followed by corrupted RF noise.

R52-02 Resolution (Mobile Safe-Area Insets & Touch Ergonomics): Implemented `SafeAreaInsets` struct and `safe_area_insets()` in `crates/mp-app/src/platform.rs` with `MIN_TOUCH_TARGET = 44.0`, dynamic `MP_SAFE_AREA_*` environment overrides, and platform defaults for iOS (top 47pt, bottom 34pt) and Android (top 32pt, bottom 24pt). Integrated into `crates/mp-app/src/app.rs` by adding `insets.top` to top bar height and positioning, enforcing `MIN_TOUCH_TARGET` on top menu items, padding left and right edges, and applying `insets.left`, `insets.right`, and `insets.bottom` to `CentralPanel` inner margins.

R52-02 Resolution (Mobile Code Signing & Provisioning Validator): Created `scripts/validate_mobile_signing.py` supporting CLI subcommands `check-ios-profile`, `check-ios-app`, and `check-android-keystore`. Extracts XML plists from CMS/PKCS#7 signedData wrappers, validates profile expiration and team identifiers, enforces required entitlements (`application-identifier`, `com.apple.developer.networking.multicast`, `keychain-access-groups`), validates iOS app bundles (`Info.plist`, binary, `embedded.mobileprovision`, `CodeResources`), and verifies Android release keystores. Created `scripts/test_mobile_signing.py` with 7/7 passing unit tests.
